title: Discrete dynamics, coding and probability
description: Four lessons on return maps, symbolic itineraries, pushforward measures and transport across scales. The Collatz iteration provides a sustained case study connecting these general subjects through exact proofs, worked examples and solved exercises.

lessons.title: Return maps and exact changes of clock
First passage and transport across scales

level: Opening two lessons: proof-based undergraduate; probability lessons: beginning graduate
prerequisites: Positive-integer arithmetic, induction and well-ordering; the second lesson also uses division with remainder. The third and fourth add elementary limits, real completeness, logarithms and integration of elementary functions. All specialised return-map, coding, pushforward and transport arguments are proved in the lessons.
